sentences.en: mind waiting, right?
sentences.zh: 不介意等待了，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's kind of the idea is they can suddenly see why they're waiting, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是其中的理念，他们突然能明白为什么要等了，对吧？

sentences.en: They know that they're not just like waiting around for no reason.
sentences.zh: 他们知道自己不是无缘无故地在那儿干等。

sentences.en: They're waiting for something that will improve their travel experience.
sentences.zh: 他们是在等待能改善旅行体验的事情完成。

sentences.en: And the other thing that Yabe did was he let the cleaners speak with the passengers, which
sentences.zh: 矢部做的另一件事是允许清洁工与乘客交流，这

sentences.en: was forbidden under the previous leader.
sentences.zh: 在前任领导的管理下是被禁止的。

sentences.en: So he provided transparency from the passengers to the employees and from the employees back
sentences.zh: 所以他实现了从乘客到员工，以及从员工回到

sentences.en: to the passengers.
sentences.zh: 乘客之间的透明度。

sentences.en: And it completely changed the experience of working at Tess A, but it also completely changed
sentences.zh: 这彻底改变了在Tess A的工作体验，也彻底改变了

sentences.en: the experience of waiting for service on the Shinkansen.
sentences.zh: 在新干线等待服务时的体验。

sentences.en: And it fundamentally changed the dynamics of those interactions.
sentences.zh: 它从根本上改变了这些互动之间的动态。

sentences.en: So in what ways did it actually change?
sentences.zh: 那么，它实际上在哪些方面发生了改变呢？

sentences.en: So, well, for one, the trains were actually getting cleaned on time.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，列车确实能准时完成清洁了。

sentences.en: So the system was working better overall, but Tess A workers were struggling a lot less
sentences.zh: 所以整个系统运作得更好了，而Tess A的员工在

sentences.en: to do their job.
sentences.zh: 完成工作时也轻松多了。

sentences.en: And that's partly because passengers were cleaning up after themselves a lot more.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上是因为乘客们更自觉地清理自己的垃圾了。

sentences.en: They could sort of see, one, you know, there are people who are doing this work and it
sentences.zh: 他们能看到，你知道，有人在做这项工作，这

sentences.en: kind of made them more conscientious about their environment and what they were doing.
sentences.zh: 让他们对周围的环境以及自己的行为更加负责了。

sentences.en: But it also sort of flipped this experience of waiting totally on its head.
sentences.zh: 但这也彻底颠覆了这种等待的体验。

sentences.en: People started to ride the Shinkansen so they could watch Tess A crews performing their work.
sentences.zh: 人们开始乘坐新干线，就为了观看Tess A团队的工作过程。

sentences.en: In Japan, they call this the seven-minute miracle.
sentences.zh: 在日本，他们称之为“七分钟奇迹”。

sentences.en: Sometimes they call it Shinkansen theater.
sentences.zh: 有时他们称之为“新干线剧场”。

sentences.en: So at the end of every cleaning, the crew does a bow and passengers applaud.
sentences.zh: 所以每次清洁结束时，团队会鞠躬，乘客们会鼓掌。

sentences.en: So it isn't just we make the waiting process transparent and therefore easier to handle.
sentences.zh: 所以这不仅仅是我们让等待过程透明化，从而更容易处理。

sentences.en: It also just like the transparency makes people realize that everyone's working really hard
sentences.zh: 这种透明度也让人们意识到每个人都在努力工作，

sentences.en: and everyone wants to take pride in this train that they're on.
sentences.zh: 每个人都想为他们所乘坐的这列火车感到自豪。

sentences.en: And it makes the world just a better place in general when we recognize that people are
sentences.zh: 当我们认识到周围的人都在辛勤工作时，世界也会变得更美好。

sentences.en: doing hard work around us.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个美丽的故事。
